NASA supports M2 as a gravitationally bound globular cluster in Aquarius, ~37,000 ly away, >150 ly diameter, >150,000 stars, central mass concentration, outward stellar streams, visible/IR Hubble core image, telescope resolution, and ideal naked-eye conditions.
IAU defines constellations as bounded sky regions rather than physical line figures.
Opened the official Auriga IAU chart (text extraction is empty, but the one-page PDF source opened).
